content.what_it_is: MATLAB script for the FUNWAVE-TVD wave_coherence case plotting the RMS wave-height field of the Case_DATA2D_1Wave run. Inputs (L4-L7): case directory, coordinates x=2:2:500, y=2:2:1000, mean-output number file_no=1. It loads Hrms_00001 and mask_00000 (L10-L12), NaNs dry cells H(mask==0)=nan (L13), plots pcolor(x,y,H) with jet colormap, colorbar labeled 'Hrms, m', caxis [0 0.8], xlim [150 inf], aspect 350:1000 (L15-L21), overlays copper-colored dots at dry (NaN) cells as sand (L22-L31), and saves figures/Hrms.jpg (L33-L34), closing the figure (L35).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
file_no — mean-output number, reformatted to 5-digit string (L7, L10)
H — RMS wave height from Hrms_00001, dry cells NaN (L11, L13)
XX_Dry, YY_Dry — coordinates of dry cells (L27-L28)
